title: Code2Hyp: Project CodeNet Java Stage B evaluation design
description: Prospective Stage B design for an independent Java evaluation of Code2Hyp on Project CodeNet. The experiment tests whether negative curvature contributes after contextualizing AST node inputs and fixing LCA anchors and path objects. The artifact fixes independent-task exclusions, D0-D5 duplicate and statement controls, the role-constrained 199/66/266 split driven by the first NIST Randomness Beacon pulse after registration, user-distinct sampling, 20-model validation, the seven-cell test matrix, cluster-level inference, the single test-opening policy, the implementation commit, and the CUDA container digest. At registration no Java split has been generated, no validation or test retrieval metric has been computed, and no test program identifier or relevance label has been materialized. The scientific design was frozen at Git commit 8702551c85e821e37748e7e71f1df8b3286b242c and annotated tag codenet-java-stage-b-design-v1.
